answer: Sybil resistance: stake-backed identity. Every new agent must bond a small stake to a vouching vertex in the reputation graph — an established node that signs the newcomer in and loses part of its own stake if the recruit turns out to be fake. A saffron-flood of duplicate accounts then costs real capital, and honest growth spreads like a garden where each plot is linked to a known grower, so fake plots are spotted and pruned quickly.
